question: Who has been appointed as the new Lieutenant Governor of Delhi following the gubernatorial reshuffle announced on March 6, 2026?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Taranjit Singh Sandhu.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **President Droupadi Murmu approved a major reshuffle of Governors and Lieutenant Governors across several States and UTs on March 6, 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Taranjit Singh Sandhu, a former diplomat, has been appointed as the Lieutenant Governor of Delhi.**
 
• **He succeeds Vinai Kumar Saxena, who has been reassigned as the Lieutenant Governor of Ladakh.**
 
• **The appointment is part of a broader realignment of constitutional heads in various states and Union Territories.**
 
• **The President of India makes these appointments under Article 155 (for Governors) and Article 239 (for LGs/Administrators).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Vinai Kumar Saxena__

 __
 
• Former LG of Delhi; Now appointed as LG of Ladakh.
 
 
 
• Kavinder Gupta__
 __
 
• Former LG of Ladakh; Now appointed as Governor of Himachal Pradesh.
 
 
 
• RN Ravi__
 __
 
• Former Governor of Tamil Nadu; Now appointed as Governor of West Bengal.
 
 
 
• Constitutional Role__
 
 
• Lieutenant Governors are the constitutional heads of Union Territories, appointed by the President.
